description: List the User Groups (a.k.a. Teams — named sub-groups of people inside a Workspace) and their members. Returns each group's id, name, handle and member list. Use to find a `group_id` before mentioning or assigning a group.

group_ids.description: Optional list of specific User Group ids to fetch. Omit to return all groups in the Workspace.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: list_user_groups
